essays.title: Maritime vs. Continental Governance Paradigms in the Age of AI
essays.summary: Why the historical political cycles of maritime (distributed) and continental (centralised) powers provide a vital lens for understanding AI governance, knowledge consolidation, and human organizational limits.

essays.title: The Next Great Teachers May Be the Workers AI Displaces
essays.summary: Why the rising gap in human-led education and the displacement of skilled workers by AI present a symbiotic opportunity: turning high-level technical workers into the next generation of process-oriented educators.

cover.alt: Cover image showing educational and work transformation

essays.title: Multilayer Thinking: Bubble Tricks and the Age of the Ecosystem
essays.summary: The economy is the bubble economists can't fully understand because they live inside it. But within it we can build smaller, bounded games — crypto, fintech, tokenomics — that we can shape at will. Why ecosystems, not businesses, are the right unit of work today.

cover.alt: A young man blowing a large bubble filled with smoke and smaller bubbles inside it.

essays.title: Automating Our Most Human Industry: Venture Capital
essays.summary: Why VC resists automation, what crypto, DAOs, and platforms get right and wrong, and why the real opportunity is not automating VC itself but designing investable assets and multi-asset models around it.

cover.alt: A silhouetted figure on a precipice with a glowing digital brain over a circuit-board city.

essays.title: Mushrooms, not Ecosystems
essays.summary: Cambridge is famously good at growing startups — but does it keep them? A reflection on whether Cambridge is a farm for London, or the mushroom of a global wood-wide-web of innovation.

cover.alt: A surreal Cambridge college framed by tree roots and glowing mushrooms, evoking a wood-wide-web.

essays.title: The Regrettable Outcomes of the Tower of Babel and Resultant Venture Capital Jargon
essays.summary: Decoding three terms in Venture Capital — Investor Conviction, Post-Investment, and Secondary Sales — so you can understand the secret language of venture capitalists.

cover.alt: Painting of the Tower of Babel rising over a river landscape.

essays.title: Understanding Due Diligence in Venture Capital
essays.summary: First screening, business diligence, legal diligence — and the honest question every investor faces: how do you do reliable pre-seed diligence when most of the documentation simply doesn't exist yet?

cover.alt: Workers winnowing rice in a field, separating grain from chaff.

essays.title: The Cambridge Innovation Ecosystem of 2025: A VC Deep-Dive
essays.summary: $191B ecosystem, 45 acquisitions, 29 IPOs, lean valuations, and a unique licensing-led VC model. Why Cambridge produces extraordinary seed-stage outcomes — and why so many companies still get acquired rather than scaled.

cover.alt: Aerial view of King's College Chapel and surrounding Cambridge colleges in golden light.
